shots.detail_en: Hook close-up: pre-dawn laundry rooftop of the brokerage, a small table with red cloth — passbook, pager, a bowl of hot soup, one incense stick (absurd offering lineup)
shots.sub: 满："列祖列宗在上——我王满仓，今天入伙了！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Wide: Chang Hong and Hongli dragged over to 'witness the ceremony', deadpan under the drying lines
shots.sub: 满："别站着！入伙要有见证人！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Man Cang lifts the red cloth — passbook, a pile of small bills, three IOUs all reading 'Man Cang borrows from Man Cang'
shots.sub: 满："十万零八百三十六块五，全——"（哽咽）"……全给你！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Hongli takes it to count, her fingertips a blur
shots.sub: 红："十万零八百三十六块五。他连毛票都带来了。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong picks up the three self-addressed IOUs
shots.sub: 长："这三张是？" 满："利息！我对自己都收利息！"
shots.speaker: CH/MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Chang Hong pushes half the money back
shots.sub: 长："这钱我收一半。" 满（当场跪下）："哥！要收就收全的！全仓！全给！"
shots.speaker: CH/MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Chang Hong pulls him up from the ground, joking face off for the first time
shots.sub: 长："听好。三条规矩，少一条，我不收。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Rule one close-up with kinetic caption card: 'NO CRYING WHEN IT'S GONE'
shots.sub: 长："第一条——亏光了，不许哭。眼泪，补不了仓。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Rule two close-up with caption card: 'NO BORROWING TO ADD'
shots.sub: 长："第二条——不许借钱加仓。借来的钱，是替别人挡刀。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Rule three close-up with caption card: 'DAD'S PENSION NEVER ENTERS THE MARKET'
shots.sub: 长："第三条——你爹的养老钱，永远不进市场。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Man Cang stunned, eyes brimming
shots.sub: 满："哥……你连我爹都想到了……"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: by the stairs his father arrives with a soup ladle to hang laundry and freezes at the scene
shots.sub: 满爹："跪啥呢这是？" 满："入伙！" 满爹："好好入。"
shots.speaker: 满爹/MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Chang Hong splits the money in two — 'war funds' he keeps, 'survival funds' he pushes back into Man Cang's arms
shots.sub: 满："保命金是什么？" 长："亏光也不许动的那一份。记住——市场永远快你一步。我也一样。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG/CH

shots.detail_en: Explosive wide: Man Cang burns the three self-addressed IOUs in public, firelight washing the rooftop (the end of his self-usury, absurd visual peak)
shots.sub: 满："从今天起——我满仓，只欠我自己！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: his pager chirps once; Man Cang solemnly places the pager onto the incense altar too
shots.sub: 满："还有我的魂——也押了！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Hongli suppresses a laugh while bookkeeping, pen hesitating before writing 'Partner: Wang Mancang (capital: one soul)'
shots.sub: 红："账上，我给你立成'风险备用金'。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Chang Hong blows out the incense in one breath (no god-worshipping — ceremony ends)
shots.sub: 长："别拜了。市场不收香，只收规矩。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Montage in first light: laundry lines, three long shadows (Chang Hong, Hongli, Man Cang) standing at the rooftop edge — the trio's founding silhouette frame
shots.sub: 旁白："那天天没亮。我们仨的本金加起来，不到熊天成一顿茶钱。可K线从不管你钱多少——它只看你，站在哪一边。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong gazes at the Lianhua Tower skyline, eyes narrowing
shots.sub: 长（旁白）："熊天成。我的账，快凑齐了。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："三个人的'小组'开张第一天——熊伟的算法，已经听见了脚步声。"
shots.card: 三个人的'小组'开张第一天——熊伟的算法，已经听见了脚步声。
